objective: Repair the Gaussian process predictive variance by a principled method rather than by inflating it, and validate the repair on the held-out solves that exposed the defect, so the posterior variance can eventually be trusted to carry a band instead of being quarantined
rationale: The defect is measured, quarantined and sharply diagnosed, which is the best possible starting position and also the reason it has sat untouched. On the flat-plate coefficient study the held-out standardised residual root-mean-square is 2.91 for the drag coefficient and 2.86 for the skin-friction station, so the errors are roughly three times the standard deviation the process claimed for them. The diagnosis is not a fit failure: mean quality transfers, with held-out predictive scores near 0.963 for both quantities, and leave-one-out standardised residuals are honest at 0.87 and 0.87 with leave-one-out scores above 0.99. So the mean generalises and the variance does not, and the gap between an honest leave-one-out calibration and a dishonest held-out calibration is the whole finding. That pattern points at specific, nameable causes rather than at a vague need for more data: hyperparameters set by maximising a marginal likelihood are a point estimate whose uncertainty is discarded, the fitted noise standard deviation sits near 2.8e-8 against a signal standard deviation near 2.3e-4 so the process is effectively interpolating and has no room to admit solver settle noise, and the leave-one-out estimate reuses the same hyperparameters it is grading, which is precisely how a calibration check becomes optimistic. Each of those has a principled repair in the lineage the strategy names, and each is testable against the same 10 held-out solves without running anything. The containment is already verified and must be preserved: the bars are inert today, nothing routes the process variance into the composed or expanded totals, and the strategy's word for the repair is principled, not inflated, so a variance-scaling factor fitted to the held-out set would be the one outcome that fails the clause while appearing to satisfy it. Axis A: reading-kind at zero solver cost, since every solve it needs is on disk. Axis B: 0 today, and the point of the repair is to make a wall-facing band eventually possible. Axis C: 0.

cost_basis: measured; the 42 training solves and the 10 held-out solves that expose the defect are already spent and on disk, the repair and its validation are refits over those stored evaluations, so no solver time is spent and no case is opened
expected_knowledge_gain: Three outcomes that separate cleanly on the same held-out set. One: a principled treatment brings the held-out standardised residual root-mean-square near one, in which case the process variance becomes admissible as an uncertainty channel and the doctrine's transferred model-form channel gets the instrument it was written for. Two: the treatment improves the calibration but not to one, in which case the residual overconfidence is quantified and the bars stay quarantined with a stated size rather than a vague warning. Three: no principled treatment closes the gap on this case, which would say the defect is not in the process at all but in the design or in the solver noise floor, and that redirects the work rather than ending it. The by-product in every branch is an honest calibration protocol that does not reuse hyperparameters to grade themselves.
